product_overview: The PG Management Backend System is an Express.js API for managing PG/hostel operations end to end, including authentication, property inventory, tenant lifecycle, rent billing, payments, complaints, announcements, notifications, and analytics. It provides role-based workflows for owners and tenants through JWT-secured REST endpoints and Razorpay integration.
core_goals: Provide secure JWT-based authentication and role-based access control for owners and tenants
Enable full management of property hierarchy including floors, rooms, and beds
Support tenant onboarding, bed assignment, checkout, and historical record keeping
Automate monthly rent generation and support both online and offline payment tracking
Integrate Razorpay payment order creation, verification, receipts, and proof review
Allow tenants to file complaints and owners to track resolution status
Broadcast announcements and deliver user notifications within the property
Expose analytics for occupancy, revenue, and operational dashboard metrics

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Handles user registration, login, OTP verification, and authenticated profile management for owners and tenants.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid user details and optional documents -> Receive 201 with created account details -> POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with authenticated profile
POST /api/auth/send-otp with a valid phone number -> Receive 200 confirming OTP dispatch -> POST /api/auth/verify-otp with correct OTP -> Receive 200 with authenticated session or token

POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> GET /api/auth/me without Bearer token -> Receive 401 authentication required response -> PUT /api/auth/profile without valid token -> Receive 401 or 403 access denied response

features.name: Property Management API
features.description: Manages the PG property profile, floor structure, rooms, beds, and occupancy status.
user_flows: GET /api/pg/property without auth -> Receive 200 with public property details -> POST /api/auth/login with owner credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PUT /api/pg/property with Bearer token and updated property data -> Receive 200 with saved property settings

GET /api/pg/hierarchy without auth -> Receive 200 with full floor-room-bed hierarchy -> POST /api/pg/floors with owner Bearer token -> Receive 201 with new floor created -> POST /api/pg/rooms with owner Bearer token and floor reference -> Receive 201 with new room created -> POST /api/pg/beds with owner Bearer token and room reference -> Receive 201 with new bed created

POST /api/pg/floors with invalid or missing owner token -> Receive 401 or 403 access denied response -> PUT /api/pg/rooms/:id with missing room data -> Receive 400 validation error -> DELETE /api/pg/beds/:id for a non-existent bed -> Receive 404 not found response

features.name: Tenant Management API
features.description: Supports tenant onboarding, bed assignment, tenant lookup, emergency contact search, checkout, and archive history.
user_flows: POST /api/tenants with owner Bearer token and tenant details -> Receive 201 with tenant record created -> POST /api/tenants/:id/assign-bed with owner Bearer token and bed ID -> Receive 200 with bed assigned -> GET /api/tenants/:id with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with detailed tenant profile

GET /api/tenants with Bearer token and filters -> Receive 200 with filtered tenant list -> GET /api/tenants/emergency-search with search query -> Receive 200 with matched emergency contact data -> GET /api/tenants/history/archive with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with archived tenant records

POST /api/tenants with missing required tenant information -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /api/tenants/:id/assign-bed with occupied or invalid bed ID -> Receive 409 or 404 error response -> POST /api/tenants/:id/checkout for an already checked-out tenant -> Receive 400 or 404 error response

features.name: Rent Management API
features.description: Generates monthly rent records, exposes billing statistics, and records offline payments.
user_flows: POST /api/rent/generate with owner Bearer token -> Receive 200 with monthly rent bills generated -> GET /api/rent/records with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with rent records and payment statuses -> GET /api/rent/stats with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with rent collection summary

POST /api/rent/record-payment with owner Bearer token and receipt details -> Receive 200 with offline payment recorded -> GET /api/rent/records with filters -> Receive 200 with updated paid status -> GET /api/payment/receipt/:receiptNo with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with receipt data

POST /api/rent/generate without owner privileges -> Receive 403 access denied response -> POST /api/rent/record-payment with invalid receipt or amount -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /api/rent/stats without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: Payment & Gateway API
features.description: Handles Razorpay order creation and verification, payment history, receipts, proof submissions, and manual review workflows.
user_flows: POST /api/payment/create-order with Bearer token and valid rent reference -> Receive 200 with Razorpay order details -> Complete payment in Razorpay -> POST /api/payment/verify with payment identifiers and signature -> Receive 200 with settled payment record -> GET /api/payment/details/:paymentId with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with payment details

POST /api/payment/submit-proof with Bearer token and uploaded screenshot -> Receive 200 with proof submitted -> GET /api/payment/proofs with owner Bearer token -> Receive 200 with pending manual proofs -> POST /api/payment/proofs/:id/verify with owner Bearer token and approval decision -> Receive 200 with proof approved or rejected -> GET /api/payment/history with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with payment history

POST /api/payment/create-order with invalid rent ID or amount -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /api/payment/verify with invalid Razorpay signature -> Receive 400 or 401 verification failure -> GET /api/payment/proofs without owner privileges -> Receive 403 access denied response

features.name: Complaints API
features.description: Allows tenants to file maintenance complaints and owners to review and update complaint status.
user_flows: POST /api/complaints with Bearer token, complaint details, and optional photo -> Receive 201 with complaint ticket created -> GET /api/complaints with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with complaint list -> PUT /api/complaints/:id/status with owner Bearer token -> Receive 200 with updated complaint status

POST /api/complaints with missing issue category or description -> Receive 400 validation error -> PUT /api/complaints/:id/status without owner privileges -> Receive 403 access denied response -> PUT /api/complaints/:id/status for non-existent complaint -> Receive 404 not found response

features.name: Announcements API
features.description: Publishes property-wide announcements and allows authenticated users to view notices.
user_flows: POST /api/announcements with owner Bearer token and announcement content -> Receive 201 with announcement published -> GET /api/announcements with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with announcement list -> DELETE /api/announcements/:id with owner Bearer token -> Receive 200 with announcement removed

GET /api/announcements without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> POST /api/announcements with non-owner token -> Receive 403 access denied response -> DELETE /api/announcements/:id for missing announcement -> Receive 404 not found response

features.name: Notifications API
features.description: Delivers user-specific in-app notifications and supports read-state updates.
user_flows: GET /api/notifications with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with current user notifications -> PUT /api/notifications/:id/read with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with notification marked read -> PUT /api/notifications/read-all with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with all notifications marked read

GET /api/notifications without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> PUT /api/notifications/:id/read for invalid notification ID -> Receive 404 not found response -> PUT /api/notifications/read-all with expired token -> Receive 401 authentication failed response

features.name: Analytics & Dashboard API
features.description: Provides high-level dashboard KPIs, occupancy analytics, and financial summaries for operational insight.
user_flows: GET /api/analytics/dashboard-summary with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with tenant, occupancy, rent, and complaint KPIs -> GET /api/analytics/occupancy with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with floor-wise and room-wise occupancy breakdown -> GET /api/analytics/financial with owner Bearer token -> Receive 200 with revenue and collection metrics

GET /api/analytics/dashboard-summary without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> GET /api/analytics/financial with tenant token -> Receive 403 access denied response -> GET /api/analytics/occupancy with malformed token -> Receive 401 authentication failure response
